name: Personal Assistant Bot
summary: Telegram bot @hermes_rheotelgchebpsdo_bot. Runs on the workstation and serves the Life-Boat, Orchestrator, Personal-assistant and General topics of the 'Concil of bots' forum group; each topic maps to its own Hermes profile.
notes: DIFFERENT BOT from hermes-gateway on the VPS, even though both post into 'Concil of bots'. This one is Telegram bot id 8770869266 and owns topics 1/2/3/695; the VPS hermes-gateway is bot id 8208050780 and owns only topics 303 (excersize bot) and 306 (Diet Bot). No shared token, so they do not conflict. Topic personas come from telegram.channel_prompts plus gateway.profile_routes.telegram.topics: 2 -> life-advisor, 3 -> orchestrator, 695 -> office-work. A topic must be listed in telegram.allowed_topics or its messages are silently ignored. Known failure mode: the gateway process stays alive while Telegram long-polling wedges after the recurring ~04:10 'Bad Gateway' reconnect ('forcing drain and restart without clean stop'); symptom is zero 'inbound message' lines in gateway.log while the process is up, and every topic goes quiet. Restarting the gateway is the fix.
